tags.name: Dari Laut
tags.qa_note: WRECK RE-AUDIT 2026-08-18 (4 sources cross-checked): McFadyen (live, confirmed) hedges cause of sinking as EITHER natural sinking OR deliberate burning for insurance -- does not confirm fire as fact. eazytraveler.net and paparazsea.com both report the fire/insurance-fraud narrative as local rumor only, not confirmed fact. scubadiverlife.com and paparazsea.com both independently describe it as a former floating casino (paparazsea specifies 'late 70s or early 80s'); scubaspotadvisor.com describes it instead as a barge-turned-floating-resort operating in the 1970s -- decade and exact nature (casino vs. resort/hotel) are DISPUTED across sources, not confirmed. Existing description overstated certainty on the fire cause -- corrected to reflect genuine source disagreement. Depth cross-check: McFadyen states 12m (shallow) to 25m (deepest) -- consistent with existing 12-13m/25-28m range within normal source variance. No build date, tonnage, or dimensions found in any of the 4 sources -- remains unknown. linesoflatitudes.home.blog returned HTTP 403 on re-check and was dropped from validation_source in favor of newly verified live sources. Scorpionfish added to marine life (scubadiverlife.com, site-specific).
